what: The 17 inline cards: plain parts in the Cards defaults from a fresh expansion (plain), the recorded pass applied to the recorded card (recorded), the pass with --blocks on the fresh expansion (blocks), the same request written with blocks, examples/showcase/site (blockcards). The recorded column is not a fair one: those cards were expanded by an older notation and carry faults it had then (unread values, an empty gallery).
judges: Judges: Opus and Sonnet subagents of a Claude Code session, shown the versions unlabeled and shuffled (ways.py pack); not judge.py, because no API key was at hand.

judgments.why: B has the richest, best-balanced hierarchy with status pill and explained warning; C is clean but plain; A bleeds to the frame edges; D is underdesigned with weak, tiny actions.
B and A have clear hierarchy, icons and a strong danger callout; D is cramped with tiny buttons.
D is a polished, shipped-looking carousel with peek, thumbnails and clear hierarchy; B is clean with a strong hero; A is serviceable but plain; C uses a generic placeholder image and weak type.
D is rich with peek of next card, thumbnails and details; B has a real illustration; C has a gray placeholder.
A is richly crafted with stepper, product art and a strong sticky footer; B is tidy and consistent; C has misaligned steppers and flat hierarchy; D shows an unfilled progress bar and uneven insets.
A has stepper, product thumbnails and a strong subtotal/CTA bar; D has an empty progress track and tiny steppers.

A is a polished diff reviewer with named hunks, gutters and a summary footer; B is close but slightly plainer; C renders code in a proportional font with weak structure; D leaks template code in the subtitle and has a label-less apply button.
A has file context, clear hunk titles and a status footer; D has garbled count text and a blank button.

C uses a highlighted winner column, checkmarks and in-column CTAs for the clearest comparison; B is solid with a strong recommendation block; A is tidy but small buttons; D has oversized row labels and weak value emphasis.
C uses a highlighted winner column with checkmarks and compact rows; D repeats noisy badges with weak hierarchy.

D is a complete, polished dashboard with populated table and annotated charts; C looks good but its table is empty; A has an empty table and crude charts; B shows broken template characters in place of every KPI and revenue value.
D is complete, polished with icons, axis labels, data-filled table; B shows broken KPI and revenue values, A and C have empty tables.

A is a clean, aligned table with proper search, tabs and status pills; C and D share a missing-glyph header and headers that do not match the stacked columns, C framing it slightly better; B adds gray status pills and the weakest hierarchy.
A is a clean aligned real table with search and status chips; others have a broken sort glyph and misaligned headers over stacked rows.

C is a polished boarding-pass style list with airport codes and a rich footer; A shares that design but the card is narrower and truncates the airline name; D is clean but generic; B has a squat confirm button and a cramped total row.
C has airport codes, route visuals and a strong footer without truncation; A truncates the airline name and sits narrow; D is plain.
B has illustrated thumbnails and a full header for a shipped feel; D is tidy with gradient placeholders; C uses flat color blocks with tight edge padding; A renders no gallery at all.
B has real illustrated tiles and a count pill; A renders only a title with no gallery.

B uses a clear timeline with illustrated day headers and grouped booking lists; D adds art but is looser; A is plain but tidy; C is excessively long with heavy expanded cards and is clipped at the bottom.
B has a clear timeline with time column, day hero banners and tidy booking cards; C is overlong with everything expanded and runs off the frame.

A pairs a detailed map with rich list rows and a header pill; B is similar with less detail; D and C have misaligned chevrons that wander across rows, with C also using low-contrast brown pins and a weak title.
A has a realistic map with pins, subtitles and ratings; C and D have crude maps and misaligned chevrons.

D has comfortable inputs, clear header and a strong primary action; C is solid with full-width segmented control and good buttons; A is neat but compact with small actions; B is the plainest with weak title and cramped controls.
D has comfortable spacing, a full-width tone toggle and a prominent Send; A and B have tiny actions and a cramped toggle.

C has illustrated items, rich metadata and a strong total footer; A is clean with balanced buttons; B has a squat, unbalanced action row; D uses generic placeholders, a misaligned Apply button and uneven steppers.
C has product illustrations, line totals and a strong total/CTA bar; D has placeholder images and tiny buttons.
A has a full header with status pill and a clean numbered timeline; B is nearly as polished; C uses bare system radios and flat hierarchy; D over-weights Elapsed and has a squat, thin start button.
A has numbered stepper with connectors, status pill and clear CTA; C is plain and D has a small, weak button.

D has a labeled stepper and rich option cards with icons and descriptions; B has clear full-width options and a strong Next; C mixes small chips with a big button; A has an unfilled progress bar and a tiny Next button.
D has a stepper, icon option cards with descriptions and radios; A has tiny pill options and a weak Next button.

D is a compact, purpose-built picker with date strip, stepper and summary footer; A and C are near-identical chip grids with A slightly more refined in its hint; B has floating undersized chips and no visual containment.
D uses a date strip, stepper and time grid with a summary/confirm bar; others are long, ragged chip grids with uneven columns.

C and B both have vivid hero and gradient range bars, C edging ahead with the rain callout and tighter rhythm; D has empty range bars; A uses monochrome icons, a small temperature and an hourly row that runs to the edge.
C has a polished hero with illustrated icons, rain hint and gradient range bars; D has empty range bars and A uses crude glyph icons.
